title: Druggability-dossier request
description: The request a caller (the upstream knowledge-graph / orchestrator station) sends to the simulation station. Exactly one field is required: the resolved UniProt accession the whole dossier is keyed on. The other four are optional context; when omitted they are treated as null and echoed back as null in the output's `input` block. NOTHING here is ever inferred by the station: an unsupplied mechanism_hypothesis stays `unknown`, an unsupplied as_of_date is not back-filled with today's date. The cache key a consumer may rely on is (uniprot_accession, mechanism_hypothesis, as_of_date).

uniprot_accession.description: The target, as a UniProtKB accession. The one thing the station cannot run without. Must be the RESOLVED accession, not a gene symbol or a node name — resolution is the upstream station's job.

as_of_date.description: Temporal cutoff for retrieval, ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). When set, every retrieved fact must predate it, so a hindcast cannot see evidence that did not yet exist. Null means 'as of today', with no cutoff enforced.

disease_context.description: Free text. Used ONLY to select relevant clinical precedent, never to adjust a tractability number.

interaction_to_disrupt.description: What the molecule is meant to stop — a named partner, an oligomeric state, or a catalytic function. Determines which chains constitute the site.

mechanism_hypothesis.description: The structural question being asked. British spelling, one underscore. Absent/null is equivalent to `unknown`. Never derived from the structure the station finds.
